intro.title: Capacity to Ship Packages
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function that calculates the minimum capacity needed for a ship to transport all packages within a given number of days. You will learn the core programming concept of binary search to efficiently find the optimal capacity between the maximum weight and the total sum of weights. The main technologies involved are JavaScript functions, arrays, and loops. This beginner-friendly lesson will guide you step-by-step through implementing the algorithm and testing it with example inputs.
intro.usecase: The Capacity to Ship Packages algorithm is essential for logistics and delivery systems like Amazon, FedEx, or food delivery apps. It helps determine the minimum truck capacity needed to ship all orders within a given deadline, optimizing fleet efficiency. Developers implement this in dashboard features that calculate delivery schedules, warehouse management systems that allocate resources, and route planning tools that balance load distribution. This pattern also appears in manufacturing systems scheduling production batches and cloud computing platforms allocating server resources to handle workloads within time constraints.
